premises.text: Sharing and getting local breaking news sucks: not real-time, accurate, local, or relevant enough
premises.evidence_span: sharing and getting news right now kind of sucks. There's no great way to break news

premises.text: Location-based mobile news desk: map pins, newswire list, categories, text/video/pictures, directions
premises.evidence_span: your local mobile news desk, allowing you to report, update, and read local news as it happens on your mobile phone

premises.text: Eyewitness check-in lets people on-scene add their account and media to a story
premises.evidence_span: we actually allow you to check in as an eyewitness. Once you check in as an eyewitness, you can tell people what you've seen

premises.text: Easy live posting of newsworthy items with category selection
premises.evidence_span: we make it very easy for you to post it live

premises.text: Social profiles, friend invites, and press-pass badges/rewards incentivize posting
premises.evidence_span: we also have a rewards program that we've built out in the app as well to reward people for posting the news

premises.text: Web mirrors the app for searching local news by area
premises.evidence_span: If you visit meporter.com, all you have to do is search for local news in your area

premises.text: Monetize via promoted stories, publisher data syndication, ads, and category corporate sponsors
premises.evidence_span: we're going to allow people to actually promote their news stories at the top of the search results

value.text: Users decide and report what local news matters as it happens
value.evidence_span: MePorter solves that by allowing you to decide what local news is important

causal_links.evidence_span: getting breaking news is not the best way right now
report, update, and read local news as it happens
promote their news stories at the top of the search results
